description: This file contains a BenchmarkDotNet benchmarking class for testing Orleans' map-reduce capabilities with complex processing pipelines. It includes setup, cleanup, and core benchmarking logic for orchestrating grains, linking processing stages, and executing repeated benchmarks with concurrent pipelines.

classes.name: MapReduceBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class that tests Orleans' map-reduce operations by setting up a cluster, orchestrating grain processing pipelines, and measuring performance with multiple parallel executions.

methods.name: BenchmarkSetup
methods.description: Initializes a test Orleans cluster before benchmarking.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops all silos and cleans up resources after benchmarking.

methods.name: Bench
methods.description: Main benchmarking method executing multiple parallel processing pipelines.

methods.name: BenchCore
methods.description: Performs a single iteration of the map-reduce pipeline, initializing grains, linking stages, and processing repeated tasks.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources such as the test cluster.
